facts.business: GB Logistics Commerce Limited is engaged in Full Truckload (FTL) logistics and transportation services, and trading of agricultural commodities.
key_risks: Operational Risk: Vehicle availability, driver availability, transportation delays and operational disruptions
Market Risk: Competition, pricing pressure, fluctuations in demand and seasonal variations
Regulatory Risk: Changes in applicable laws and regulations, including GST, e-way bill requirements and motor vehicle regulations
Financial Risk: Customer credit cycles, liquidity requirements and working capital management
Business Risk: Changes in market conditions, freight rates and supply-chain requirements
facts.related_party_note: The Group's has not advanced or loaned or invested funds to any other person(s) or entity(ies), including foreign entities (Intermediaries) with the understanding that the Intermediary shall directly or indirectly lend or invest in other persons or entities identified in any manner whatsoever by or on behalf of the Group's (Ultimate Beneficiaries), or provide any guarantee, security, security or the like to or on behalf of the ultimate beneficiaries. The Group's does not receive any fund from any person(s) or entity(ies), including foreign entities (Funding Party) with the understanding that the Group's shall directly or indirectly lend or invest in other persons or entities identified in any manner whatsoever by or on behalf of the Group's (Ultimate Beneficiaries), or provide any guarantee, security or the like on behalf of the Ultimate Beneficiaries.
